What is industrial operations software and what should it do?

Industrial operations software connects plant, ERP, supplier, and financial systems into one managed layer so exception handling, master data governance, and reporting happen in real time rather than through spreadsheet reconciliation. On UnifyApps, this runs as a set of governed agents that assemble across systems without requiring a system replacement.
What is industrial dataops and how does UnifyApps support it?

Industrial dataops is the discipline of managing data operations—ingestion, quality, governance, and lineage—across plant, ERP, and supply chain systems. UnifyApps supports it through a shared ontology and data fabric that unifies structured and unstructured plant data, validating it against your own rules before any agent or report consumes it.
What does a manufacturing intelligent operations platform do?

A manufacturing intelligent operations platform connects plant systems, ERP, and supply chain data into one model, then runs agents that automate the repetitive decisions—BOM validation, order intake, exception routing, financial reconciliation—while keeping humans in the loop on high-stakes approvals. How is financial reconciliation different with industrial operations AI?

Invoices, ledgers, and plant cost data reconcile continuously against one model of the business rather than in batch at period end. A large multi-brand operator reports $450K in annual savings and 100% real-time visibility into food wastage from the same governed foundation.
